profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that develops autonomous driving technology. On its own site the company describes itself as a commercial-stage global business working on driving automation from Level 2 through Level 4, and says its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries. It lists its shares on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800, and is registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001867729.

The company describes a single universal platform, WeRide One, along with a self-developed foundational toolchain and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. It says it offers a portfolio of five core products, among them Robotaxi, and that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. These are the company's own characterizations of its technology and market position.

The available record contains no litigation, no separately tracked product entries, and no MCP server listings for the company.
